top_signals.title: Japan Bond Volatility Is Pumping Up Futures Trading in Singapore
top_signals.summary: Global funds and relative-value traders are driving a surge in Japan bond futures trading in Singapore, drawn by rising volatility.

top_signals.title: SEC proposes new crypto offering rules as Congress stalls on digital asset legislation
top_signals.summary: On Tuesday, the SEC proposed a new rule that seeks to offer a pathway for investments involving digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
